content.purpose: Provide a DID-addressed aviation operations service (airport + aircraft + flight + incident) as an auditable, open-source reference implementation.

architectureDescriptionContext.mission: Provide tamper-evident, DID-native aviation operations primitives open to any AT Protocol client.

content.findings: OOOI checkpoints + status state machine sufficient for post-hoc operations record. Severity DMN routes accidents/serious-incidents to authority audit feed.
content.recommendations: Add ADS-B realtime subscription, Annex 13 occurrence category taxonomy, predictive delay model integration.
